title.zh: 正交性、投影与最小二乘

lead.en: Derive the closest-point projection and normal equations without calculus, construct QR, distinguish unique fits from unique weights, and diagnose numerical and modelling limits.
lead.zh: 不用微积分推导最近点投影与正规方程，构造 QR，区分拟合与权重唯一，诊断数值和建模限制。

prerequisites.en: Module 11: bases, four fundamental spaces, rank–nullity, and null-space parameter equivalence. Recall the dot product and Euclidean norm from Module 09.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 11：基、四基本空间、秩–零化度与零空间参数等价。回顾模块 09 点积及欧几里得范数。

en: Define an inner product and justify orthogonal Pythagorean decompositions.
Derive vector/subspace projections and their uniqueness.
Construct Gram–Schmidt and verify a reduced QR factorisation.
Solve full-column-rank least squares by QR with every shape explicit.
Prove normal-equation necessity and sufficiency without differentiation.
Describe rank-deficient minimisers and the unique minimum-norm representative.
Separate numerical solution quality, coefficient sensitivity and future predictive claims.
zh: 定义内积并说明正交勾股分解。
推导向量及子空间投影与唯一性。
构造格拉姆–施密特并核对约化 QR。
用 QR 解满列秩最小二乘，明确全部形状。
不用求导证明正规方程必要与充分。
描述秩亏最小化族与唯一最小范数代表。
区分数值求解质量、系数敏感性与未来预测主张。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and prove the closest-point claim.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并证明最近点命题。
阅读解析几何投影选段。

text.en: Explore projections and explain the chosen metric.
text.zh: 探索投影并解释选定度量。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and construct the two-column QR example.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，构造两列 QR 例子。
运行投影与格拉姆–施密特检查。

title.zh: 正规方程与非唯一权重

text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，包括最小范数几何。

text.en: Fit by QR and analyse a duplicate-feature family.
text.zh: 用 QR 拟合并分析重复特征族。

text.en: Compare Gram rounding with QR and perturb the target.
text.zh: 比较格拉姆舍入与 QR，并扰动目标。

text.en: Complete choices and the written residual proof.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面残差证明。

text.en: Read the official QR and least-squares contracts.
text.zh: 阅读官方 QR 与最小二乘约定。

text.en: Complete the exit task and separate fitting from generalisation.
text.zh: 完成结业任务，区分拟合与泛化。
